meaning_en: Kill switch: {var} is set — no call to the external API goes out while it is
meaning_zh: 紧急停止：已设置 {var}——在它被取消之前，不会向外部接口发出任何调用

meaning_en: Kill switch: {path} exists — remove it to allow calls again
meaning_zh: 紧急停止：{path} 存在——删除它之后才会再次允许调用

meaning_en: Writes refused: {var} is not an absolute path, so the {file} kill-switch file cannot be checked
meaning_zh: 拒绝写入：{var} 不是绝对路径，因此无法检查紧急停止文件 {file}

meaning_en: Writes are off: only {var}=1 enables them (credentials alone never do)
meaning_zh: 写入已关闭：只有 {var}=1 才会开启（仅有凭据不会开启）

meaning_en: {method} {path} is not on the write allowlist
meaning_zh: {method} {path} 不在允许写入的清单上

meaning_en: {method} {path}: fields {fields} are not an allowed set; allowed: {allowed}
meaning_zh: {method} {path}：字段 {fields} 不是允许的组合；允许的是：{allowed}

meaning_en: {method} {path}: {id} is not an entity the harness created — only those may be changed this way
meaning_zh: {method} {path}：{id} 不是本系统创建的对象——只有本系统创建的才能这样修改

meaning_en: {method} {path}: the value of {field} is not allowed
{method} {path} did not complete ({detail}); it is recorded as failed and never sent again
meaning_zh: {method} {path} 没有完成（{detail}）；已记为失败，不会重发
